crossRefs.note: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to…
Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers,

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
translations.bsb: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
translations.kjv: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
translations.asv: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it: and Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
